name: Improvement cycle — select targets, leaf-curate + verify each, synthesize seams, card to genesis
description: ONE cycle of the self-improving loop (built + proven 2026-07-17/18, see papers/agentruntime/memory-as-workflow-loop.md): a selector picks 3 fresh high-value targets (git churn + drift signals, avoiding already-carded ones), 3 parallel LEAF-CURATOR agents each analyze->adversarially-self-verify->route their target and emit a genesis card of VERIFIED findings, a synthesis agent finds cross-cutting seams across the three digests (confirming in code before claiming), and the cycle summary whispers back. SAFE BY DESIGN: finds/verifies/cards only — no auto-fix, no merges; genesis is the human triage gate. Repetition is the CALLER's job (repeated POSTs, chrono, or an atb listener) — a DAG is acyclic, one POST = one cycle. Per-node timeoutMs bounds every agent (a hung curator is reaped, unlike SDK-side loops). Params (ALL REQUIRED — an unfilled param passes through literally and fails the node loudly, same contract as divergent-reasoning-custom): notify (who gets the summary, e.g. claude), curatorModel (e.g. claude-opus-4-8 — verification quality is model-dependent, do NOT cheap out on the curator tier: a weak curator launders unverified claims), scope (prose hint for the selector, e.g. 'packages/* and dependencies/*'). Standard invocation: POST /workflow {"workflow":"improvement-cycle","async":true,"params":{"notify":"claude","curatorModel":"claude-opus-4-8","scope":"packages/* and dependencies/*"}}.

params.prompt:
You are the SELECTOR for one improvement cycle over the agentruntime monorepo (cwd). Pick the 3 highest-value FRESH targets to scan. Scope hint: {{params.scope}}.

Method (deterministic signals first): (1) git log --since='21 days ago' --name-only for churn hot-spots; (2) check cartridges/genesis/state/board.json for cards whose collapseKey starts with 'auto-' — their targets were ALREADY scanned, avoid them; (3) prefer targets where docs/README likely drifted from code or tests look thin. If packages/memory/src/selection.ts's deterministic scorer is wired to a CLI, prefer it; otherwise your judgment over the signals above is fine.

Reply with EXACTLY three lines, each a repo-relative directory (e.g. packages/foo or dependencies/bar or src/workflows), best first. No prose, no numbering — three bare paths on three lines.

meta.description: Deterministic-signal selector. Its 3-line reply is split by the lane prompts (lane N takes line N).

params.prompt:
You are LEAF CURATOR lane 1 of an improvement cycle. The selector chose these targets (one per line):
{{nodes.select.result.reply}}

YOUR TARGET IS THE FIRST LINE. Curate it fully:
1. ANALYZE: actively read its README/docstrings (intended) + src (built) with your tools. Find 2-4 REAL gaps/bugs/drift, each citing real repo-relative file paths. North star: agentruntime = container runtime for AI agents; verified/honest state over asserted; Honest Response Principle.
2. VERIFY (what makes you a curator, not a finder): path-check every ref; adversarially spot-check your sharpest claims by re-reading the code; KILL any finding you cannot confirm — a laundered claim is worse than none.
3. ROUTE each survivor: auto-fix (clear/safe/verified) | escalate (design or values call) | drop.
4. CARD IT: write a JSON file (use your file tools) of shape {"tag":"@agentruntime/genesis:capture","caller":"improvement-cycle","payload":{"agent":"improvement-cycle-lane1","source":"conversation","collapse_key":"auto-<target-with-dashes>","title":"Auto-scan: <n> verified finding(s) in <target>","why":"Leaf-curator-verified by the improvement cycle; for human triage, NOT auto-fixed.","note":"<one line per verified finding: [route, confidence] title — evidence file:line>"}} then POST it: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:39827/emit-event -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @<file>. Confirm the response lists genesis in observers.
5. Reply with a compact digest: target, findings table (title | verified? | route | confidence | file:line evidence), an honest could-not-verify note, and card-posted confirmation.

meta.description: Leaf curator lane 1 — the proven analyze->self-verify->route->card mandate. Digest feeds synthesis.

Cycle summary back to the operator's conversation. Genesis holds the durable output.
